question: What constitutes the best width for the relevant pedestal component?
premises: The channel chamber is divided into three parts.
One of these parts is taken as a measure.
This measure is designated the best width.
inference: The best width is one third of the channel chamber.
uncertainties: The precise architectural referent of nālīgṛha is context-dependent.
plain_english: One third of the channel chamber is taken as the best width.
